{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.16

|gr1= Curator

|descr= Register "curatorObjectRegistered" handler. Cost of vehicles with crews will be automatically calculated based on vehicle + crew cost.

|s1= [curator, code] call [[BIS_fnc_curatorObjectRegistered]]

|p1= curator: [[Object]] - curator module

|p2= code: [[Code]] - handler code, passed arguments are:<br>
0: [[Object]] - Curator<br>
1: [[Array]] - Classes

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>[curatorModule, { hint format ["Curator:%1, Classes:%2", _this # 0, _this # 1] }] call BIS_fnc_curatorObjectRegistered;</sqf>
